'''Turnell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] SpecOps [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]], he was stationed near an [[anti-aircraft gun]] in the [[Overgrown Trail]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
